text.damagemodifier: * 2 from ranged and 3 from melee champion basic attacks
text.spelleffects: A trap's debuff applies spell effects as persistent damage.
text.abilities:
;Stealth Trap
The trap stealths and becomes untargetable after 1.5 seconds, remaining vulnerable to trap-revealing effects at all times.

;Trap Limitation
Only up to 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 (based on level) traps may be active at once.

;Toxin
If an enemy walks over the spring trap, they are inflicted with a toxin that deals them 40 / 80 / 120 / 160 / 200 (+ 20% AP) total magic damage over 4 seconds. Additionally, they become marked as Hunted for the same duration if they were a monster or champion and Nidalee was nearby.
